column1: # H22 blind bracket sort (Opus vision subagent, 28 Sept 2026, one call, prompt verbatim in scripts/PROMPTS.md section H22; no letters, no key). Rows verbatim. Its criterion, verbatim: "group A (f108 only) has a fine hairline diagonal from the right end of the top bar down to the foot of the vertical and a foot bar longer than the top bar that tapers into a tail; group B is a plain squared C open to the right with no diagonal and the top bar longest (the f61 examples also have a short spur of the vertical above the top bar); group C is closed like a capital I, with bars on both sides of a thin vertical." Caveats verbatim: "group A's hairline diagonal nearly closes the sign into a triangle. It is kept here because of its squared-C frame and foot bar. Separate signs on f108 that have a top bar and a descending point but no foot bar were counted as triangles and excluded (...). The f108sheetB_L07 sheet cuts the cipher line off at the bottom of every segment, so its two rows are uncertain. f108sheetB_L05 has no bracket signs." "bracket signs found: 18 (16 clear + 2 uncertain on f108sheetB_L07)".
